glowny.pasek.aktualizuj_niedostepne: Updates work only in the version installed with the installer.
glowny.status.brak.podtytul: Turn on the treadmill and click Find treadmill.
glowny.status.skanowanie.podtytul: The treadmill must be on and its phone app closed.
glowny.status.szukanie.podtytul: The treadmill must be on and its phone app closed.
glowny.status.laczenie.podtytul: This usually takes a few seconds.
glowny.status.czekam.podtytul: Waiting for data from the treadmill. If it takes long, turn the treadmill off and on.
glowny.status.bt_wylaczony.podtytul: Turn it on in Start > Settings > Bluetooth & devices.
glowny.status.nieobslugiwane.tytul: This device is not a supported treadmill
glowny.status.nieobslugiwane.podtytul: Choose another device. If it is a treadmill, report it in Settings > Help and diagnostics > Report a problem.
glowny.status.symulator.podtytul: {klawisz_szybciej} speeds up, {klawisz_wolniej} slows down. Sessions do not go to the online account.
glowny.poziom.dostepnosc: Level and achievements. Click to see the details.
glowny.poziom.symulator: Levels grow only for kilometres on a real treadmill.
glowny.wskaznik.wylaczone: Control is off. {klawisz_wlaczania} turns it on.
glowny.wskaznik.czekam: Waiting for data from the treadmill…
glowny.wskaznik.chodzenie.proba: Walking · trial mode, the game gets nothing
glowny.trening.poziom_dostepnosc: Level {poziom}: {kmh} km/h. Click to set it.
glowny.sterowanie.profil_dostepnosc: Game profile: {profil}. Click to change it.
glowny.sterowanie.klawisz_dostepnosc: Control key: {klawisz_wlaczania}. Click to change it.
glowny.podpowiedz.chodzenie: Walk on the treadmill and your character walks with you: the game gets {klawisz_chodu}, and {klawisz_biegu} + {klawisz_chodu} at a faster pace. The game window must be in front.
glowny.podpowiedz.chodzenie_proba: Trial mode: the game gets no keys, so the character stands still. To make it walk, turn on Settings > Games and controls > Control > Keys in the game.
glowny.podpowiedz.klawisze: Hold {klawisz_chodu} and the belt speeds up. {klawisz_chodu} + {klawisz_biegu} is running. Let go of the key and the belt slows down.
glowny.podpowiedz.pad: Tilt the left stick: the further, the faster the belt goes. Set the steps in Settings > Games and controls > Control.
glowny.podpowiedz.trening: Click a level or use {klawisz_szybciej} and {klawisz_wolniej}. The game gets no keys.
glowny.wskaznik.chodzenie.proba_bieg: Running · trial mode, the game gets nothing
glowny.podpowiedz.klawisze_stop: Hold {klawisz_chodu} and the belt starts. Let go and it stops.
